title: login: the page looks live when the server is unreachable — no error or retry, and it falls back to offering Sign up
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: console login page served while the backend is stopped.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

With the server unreachable, seven boot reads (`runtime/config`, `auth/config`, `i18n/*`, `auth/get-session` …) return 502 silently; the form looks normal and the user finds out only on submit. Because `auth/config` failed, the page also falls back to offering "Don't have an account? Sign up" (with the server up and registration closed it is correctly hidden — objectstack-ai/objectui#11691).

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

When the config reads fail, show "Can't reach the server" with Retry instead of a live-looking form, and do not offer Sign up while the registration posture is unknown.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectstack (open and closed), *auth config disableSignUp invite only audience posture sign up advertised*: 8 hits (1 open, 7 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *login page shows nothing when backend server is unreachable network error*: 1 hits (0 open, 1 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11691 (closed) — closed 2026-10-06 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11703): the Sign-up-under-invite_only half of this card exactly
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11705 (closed) — same defect on the exported default pages
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11634 (closed) — same Sign-up-link family
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.
